# BTicino C300X Integration v2.4.0

## 2026-11-15

Version 2.4.0 adds an Energy page to the C300X display, makes the visitor
image size configurable, and fixes several call, update and repair problems
found since 2.3.0.

## Energy Page

- An optional **Energy** page joins the display's Home Assistant pages. It
  reads the sources of HA's Energy dashboard; no extra entities are needed.
- Choose up to three views: **Now** shows the flow between solar, grid,
  battery and home with current power. **Today** shows hourly bars and the
  totals per meter with costs. **Balance** shows solar used at home,
  self-sufficiency, net grid use and the day's cost.
- Enable the page and set its position under **Display pages**. Texts are
  available in German, English, French and Italian and follow HA's language.

## Visitor Images

- Choose the image size up to the display's 800x480; the default is 688x480,
  the size of the video. The device delivers that size directly and HA
  encodes the image once.
- The capture date and time can be written into the image (default on).
- New entries capture after **3 seconds** instead of 5; an existing entry
  keeps its saved delay.
- The settings have their own **Visitor Snapshot** step in setup,
  reconfiguration and options.

## Breaking Change: Forwarding States

- The **Forwarding** select now has the states `enabled`, `homeassistant` and
  `blocked`; its labels are translated like other select entities.
- Automations and scripts of your own that compare the old English texts, or
  set them with `select.select_option`, must use these three values. The
  bundled ring blueprints are updated; a copy of them that you changed or
  imported yourself must be imported again.
- HA reads the mode again after the agent restarts, so a change made on the
  display in the meantime is no longer missed. When the device's answer names
  no mode, the select shows unknown instead of unavailable.

## Display, Card and Audio

- After an area of **Configure** is saved, the settings menu is shown again,
  so several areas can be changed in one go; **Done** closes it.
- Select options on display tiles appear in HA's language, and decimal
  numbers use that language's decimal sign on every page.
- The card footer keeps its text beside the buttons at every width.
- **Tone buttons** and **HA feedback** in the device's **Settings → General**
  line up with the buttons above them.
- The MP4 of a Ring Capture keeps the device audio's sample rate and channel
  count and leaves the level untouched at 0 dB gain; `latest.raw.wav` stays
  16 kHz mono. `latest.processed.wav` and `processed_wav_path` are gone; use
  `raw_wav_path`.
- PCMU talkback reaches a PCMU device unchanged.

## Calls, Updates and Repairs

- A ring starts its talkback and preview without waiting for a video session
  that is still starting.
- **Hang up** stays on the card for an answered call whose stream failed.
- Answering a ring on a card that showed the preview sends the microphone;
  the card no longer ends up picture-only with a disabled **Busy** button.
- The Home Call ringback plays only on the card that started the call.
- A Display patch job that runs past its time limit no longer takes the
  restarted display GUI down with it.
- A display GUI restarted by the Display patch no longer holds the agent's
  video port, which could leave video dead after the next agent restart.
- The card closes its stream at once when Home Assistant ends a session
  itself, instead of showing a frozen picture.
- The Home Assistant button appears on the display when the Energy page is
  the only page set up.
- Every agent update step waits while the agent runs another maintenance job,
  and display patch, GUI reload and firewall requests wait 15 seconds. An
  update that only needed a second try no longer asks you to check the
  maintenance access.
- The device user repair stays open while any of its checks fails; a retried
  SSH installation runs every follow-up step.
- The Android ring alert stops promptly when the door opens or the call is
  answered; both ring blueprints also end on HA's own unlock event.
- A memo delete button stays usable after a failed read.

## Security

- The agent accepts UDP event frames only from the device itself. Before, any
  host on the local network could inject device events. See the
  [security policy](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-bticino-c300x/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
- The agent receives the device's video and audio packets for on-demand
  video on the loopback interface only. Before, hosts on the local network
  could send packets into a running stream.
- The agent rejects activation items and MQTT settings over its API that it
  would refuse at start.

## Upgrade

- Update the integration, then run the agent update Repair. The packaged
  native agent is **2.4.0**; it installs the display file of the Energy page.
- Reapplying an active Display patch restarts the GUI once.
- Requires Home Assistant **2026.10.0** or newer. Keep existing entries and
  cards.

## Verification Scope

The changes have local regression coverage. The Energy page was checked as a
rendered preview; this agent build has not received an end-to-end device test.
